clue.text: Time for stocking up!

parts.note: sounds like a shopping spree, but means the night children hang up stockings for gifts

explanation.surface: A shopkeeper's cheery reminder that it is the season to lay in supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stocking up' looks like buying provisions; here it is hanging up a stocking for presents to be left in.
explanation.definitionFit: The night before the 25th of December is when children traditionally hang stockings by the fireplace.

clue.text: Associate making approach about waste-disposal unit

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the word for approach goes round the other piece

parts.note: to approach is to come
a bin is where rubbish goes

explanation.surface: A firm hooks up with a partner by pitching to a recycling business.
explanation.definitionFit: To associate things is to join or unite them, a verb synonym.

clue.text: Classes needing a rest perhaps

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters of the following words might be arranged some other way

explanation.surface: Lessons that leave pupils wanting a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges the letters of A REST.
explanation.definitionFit: Rates are grades or ranks, as with first-rate or second-rate, so classes is a synonym.

clue.text: "Veronica" is to run and run

parts.note: to run fast is to speed
water that runs up from a spring is said to well

explanation.surface: A woman named Veronica is told to keep on running.
explanation.walkthrough: The quotation marks make Veronica look like a name; it is the plant genus.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is the botanical genus of small blue-flowered plants commonly called by this name.

clue.text: The sea being on either side of one

indicators.note: on either side of means the word for being is split to flank the other piece

parts.note: a human being is a man
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A lone figure surrounded by ocean on both sides.
explanation.definitionFit: The main is an old poetic name for the open ocean, as in the Spanish Main.

clue.text: Legendary place for wisdom

parts.note: a saga is a legend, so legendary stands for the noun used as an adjective
a city is a place

explanation.surface: A fabled location renowned as a seat of learning.
explanation.definitionFit: Shrewd good judgement, the quality of a sage, is a synonym of wisdom.

clue.text: Clothing offered to a goddess

parts.note: a vest is an item of clothing

explanation.surface: A garment is presented as an offering at a shrine.
explanation.definitionFit: Vesta was the Roman deity of the hearth and home.

clue.text: Big dog very good about being put on lead maybe

indicators.note: being put on signals that the earlier pieces are placed before the next one in the charade

parts.note: A1, written AI, means first-rate
re means concerning

indicators.note: maybe suggests the letters of lead could be arranged otherwise

parts.note: a dog's lead, here taken as letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A large hound behaves well when its leash is clipped on.
explanation.definitionFit: The Airedale is the largest of the terrier breeds, from Yorkshire.

clue.text: Informer starts evidence in French town

parts.note: grass is British slang for a police informer

indicators.note: starts means only the opening letter of evidence is used

explanation.surface: A police informant begins to give evidence in a case in France.
explanation.definitionFit: Grasse is a town in Provence famous for perfume making.

clue.text: Doctor sitting by the phone raising the issue

parts.note: MO is a medical officer, an army doctor
taken as written
to phone someone is to ring them

explanation.surface: A doctor waits by the telephone before bringing up a problem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Raising the issue' looks like bringing up a topic; issue means children, so it is bringing them up.
explanation.definitionFit: Issue is a formal word for offspring, and rearing offspring is the work of a parent.

clue.text: Participant in Spanish irredentist gathering

definitions.note: a noun here, though the needlework term is mainly a verb, to gather cloth

indicators.note: Participant in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone takes part in a rally of Spanish nationalists seeking lost territory.
explanation.definitionFit: In sewing, cloth drawn into parallel rows of tucks is said to be gathered this way.

clue.text: Gaoled but showing guts

definitions.meaning: gaoled means locked up in prison, slang for doing time
the interior, the innards, as of a body or a machine

explanation.surface: A prisoner proves brave despite being behind bars.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both serving a prison sentence and the interior of something, its innards.

clue.text: People who save money by fiddling?

definitions.text: People who save money by fiddling?

parts.words: People who save money by fiddling?
parts.note: reads as fraudsters cheating, but fiddling is violin playing, and the players scrimp to save

explanation.surface: Wonders whether the thrifty are actually cooking the books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fiddling' looks like cheating; poor violinists are mocked as scraping the bow, and those who scrimp scrape together money.
explanation.definitionFit: Penny-pinchers who scrape money together, and indifferent violinists who scrape at the strings.

clue.text: The fellow in shelter returning for a top-coat

indicators.note: returning means the whole assembly is read backwards
in puts the fellow inside the word for shelter

parts.note: the lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind
a fellow is a man

explanation.surface: A man ducks back into a shelter to fetch his overcoat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns LEMANE (MAN inside LEE) back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: A glossy paint or glaze applied as the final protective finishing layer is a top-coat.

clue.text: Noted ace spinning a yarn

indicators.note: spinning sets the letters of the preceding words whirling into a new order

explanation.surface: A famous flying ace tells a tall tale.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinning' rearranges NOTED ACE; it also suits spinning a yarn.
explanation.definitionFit: A yarn is an informal story, and a short amusing personal tale is a synonym.

clue.text: Cod and skate caught up in barrier

indicators.note: caught up suggests the two fish are tangled together in a net and jumbled

explanation.surface: Two kinds of fish are trapped in a fishing net or fence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caught up' rearranges COD and SKATE together.
explanation.definitionFit: A stockade is a defensive fence of upright stakes, a kind of barrier.

clue.text: Quack in cleaner part of S Africa is on the way up

parts.note: a char is a British cleaning woman, short for charwoman

indicators.note: on the way up, in a down clue, means the province name is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Natal is a province of South Africa

explanation.surface: A fraud working as a cleaner in a South African province is rising in the world.
explanation.definitionFit: A quack is a fraudulent pretender to medical skill, a cheat or impostor.

clue.text: He takes the measure of fools, endlessly kind

parts.note: asses are fools

indicators.note: endlessly means the word for kind loses its final letter

parts.note: a sort is a kind

explanation.surface: Someone sizes up idiots, though without end in a gentle way.
explanation.definitionFit: An assessor values property or evaluates work, judging its worth.

clue.text: The person wanting everything just right thought to tip

definitions.text: The person wanting everything just right

parts.note: an idea is a thought
a ship that lists tips over to one side

explanation.surface: A perfectionist has a notion about leaving a gratuity.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone pursuing perfect standards and principles over practical compromise.

clue.text: High-flier in thermal disaster

parts.note: a figure from Greek myth who flew too near the sun and whose wax wings melted

explanation.surface: A glider pilot or an ambitious executive comes to grief on a hot updraught.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Thermal' suggests a gliding updraught; the disaster is heat melting wings of wax and feathers.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, Daedalus's son flew with wax wings too close to the sun, which melted them.

clue.text: Left a temporary dwelling undeveloped

parts.note: a tent is a temporary shelter for campers

explanation.surface: Someone abandons a makeshift camp before it is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: Something hidden or dormant, not yet developed, as with a photographic image before processing.

clue.text: An attachment for the down-to-earth guy

definitions.text: An attachment for the down-to-earth guy

parts.words: An attachment for the down-to-earth guy
parts.note: a guy is the rope that holds a tent, fixed into the ground

explanation.surface: Something a practical, unpretentious man might fasten on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Guy' looks like a man and 'down-to-earth' like sensible; a guy is a tent rope literally pinned to the earth.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden or metal spike driven into soil to anchor a rope supporting canvas.

clue.text: Having a pipe in bed — getting carried away

indicators.note: in places the pipe inside the bed

parts.note: taken as written
a duct is a pipe or channel

explanation.surface: Someone smoking a pipe in bed gets too excited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carried away' looks like enthusiasm; it means kidnapped. The pipe is a channel, not tobacco.
explanation.definitionFit: To abduct is to kidnap, literally to lead or take someone off by force.

clue.text: The Arch's reminder about the Revised Version

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, linking the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: about means the word for reminder is wrapped around the other piece

parts.note: a cue is a prompt to an actor
RV is the abbreviation for the Revised Version of the Bible

explanation.surface: The Archbishop prompts the clergy about a Bible translation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Arch' suggests an archbishop with his Bible; it is just an arch.
explanation.definitionFit: An arch is a bend or bow shape, a synonym of a smoothly bent line.

clue.text: This kind of bread wins lots of points

parts.note: a glut is a large surplus
E and N are compass points, east and north

explanation.surface: A loaf variety is said to scoop many prizes.
explanation.definitionFit: Gluten bread is high in wheat protein, so the word names that kind of loaf.

clue.text: Play as a team

parts.note: reads as sporting teamwork but is a musical instruction for the whole ensemble

explanation.definitionFit: An Italian score direction meaning all performers play together.

clue.text: Stop admitting love for a real swine

indicators.note: admitting means letting the love letter inside the word for stop

parts.note: to bar is to stop
love is zero in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to accept affection from a truly nasty person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A real swine' sounds like an insult; it is an actual pig.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild or uncastrated male pig is literally a swine.

clue.text: Speak without qualification

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to say aloud; as an adjective it means total or absolute.

clue.text: A baseball player puts sportswear first

parts.note: shorts are worn for sport
top means first, as in top of the class

explanation.surface: A ballplayer chooses his kit before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: In baseball, the fielder stationed between second and third base.

clue.text: Fashion is in a sense agonising

indicators.note: in places the fashion word inside the word for a sense

parts.note: hearing is one of the five senses
a trend is a fashion

explanation.surface: Keeping up with fashion is painful, in a way.
explanation.definitionFit: Heartbreaking or distressing, causing deep anguish.
